name: bars-grow
description: 条形对比图：三条按序增长（scaleX stagger），名称+数值标签
css: #tpl-bars-grow { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .bg-hair { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 3vh; transform-origin: left center; } .bg-title { font-size: 4.6vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .bg-row { display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 1.7vh 0; } .bg-name { width: 9em; font-size: 2.1vh; opacity: .78; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); flex: none; } .bg-track { flex: 1; height: 3.2vh; background: currentColor; opacity: .14; position: relative; } .bg-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); transform-origin: left center; } .bg-val { width: 4em; text-align: right; font-size: 2.1vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); flex: none; }
body:
{{title}}
{{n1}}{{v1}}
{{n2}}{{v2}}
{{n3}}{{v3}}
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .bg-hair", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .bg-title", { y: 34, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.2);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .bg-fill", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: Math.min(1.3, {dur} * 0.45), ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.18 }, {start} + 0.5);
